title: Lightfoot mead

# Lightfoot mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadLightfoot | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Lightfoot x1 | Duration: 10m | Cooldown: 0s | Other Effect(s): -30% jump stamina cost, +20% jump height

# Introduction

Lightfoot mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Lightfoot.

## Recipe

Mead base: Lightfoot is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 2 Scale hide
• 5 Feathers
• 5 Magecap
Six Lightfoot meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Consuming it reduces jump stamina cost by 30% and increases jump height by 20% for 10 minutes.

## Trivia

• The stamina cost of jumps can be reduced to zero by combining Lightfoot mead (-30%), Feather cape (-20%) and Eikthyr Forsaken power (-60%).
